legend: Polar bears like unique arrays — that is, arrays without repeated elements.

You have got a unique array s with length n containing non-negative integers. Since you are good friends with Alice and Bob, you decide to split the array in two. Precisely, you need to construct two arrays a and b that are also of length n, with the following conditions for all i (1 ≤ i ≤ n):

Ideally, a and b should also be unique arrays. However, life in the Arctic is hard and this is not always possible. Fortunately, Alice and Bob are still happy if their arrays are almost unique. We define an array of length n to be almost unique, if and only if it can be turned into a unique array by removing no more than ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2265c348fd0c0c2877464189b0017364c212a242.png) entries.

For example, the array [1, 2, 1, 3, 2] is almost unique because after removing the first two entries, it becomes [1, 3, 2]. The array [1, 2, 1, 3, 1, 2] is not almost unique because we need to remove at least 3 entries to turn it into a unique array.
So, your task is to split the given unique array s into two almost unique arrays a and b.
input: The first line of the input contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105).
The second line contains n distinct integers s1, s2, ... sn (0 ≤ si ≤ 109).
output: If it is possible to make Alice and Bob happy (if you can split the given array), print "YES" (without quotes) in the first line. In the second line, print the array a. In the third line, print the array b. There may be more than one solution. Any of them will be accepted.
If it is impossible to split s into almost unique arrays a and b, print "NO" (without quotes) in the first line.
note: In the sample, we can remove the first two entries from a and the second entry from b to make them both unique.

legend.ai: 北极熊喜欢无重复元素的数组——也就是说，数组中不存在重复元素。
你有一个长度为 n、包含非负整数且元素互不相同的数组 s。由于你和 Alice、Bob 是好朋友，因此你决定将这个数组拆分成两个数组。具体来说，你需要构造两个长度同样为 n 的数组 a 和 b，使得对于所有 i（1 ≤ i ≤ n）都满足以下条件：

理想情况下，a 和 b 也应该是唯一数组。然而，北极的生活十分艰苦，这并不总是可行。幸运的是，如果数组近乎唯一，Alice 和 Bob 也会感到满意。我们将长度为 n 的数组定义为近乎唯一，当且仅当通过删除不超过 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2265c348fd0c0c2877464189b0017364c212a242.png) 个元素，可以将其变成唯一数组。
例如，数组 [1, 2, 1, 3, 2] 是近乎唯一的，因为删除前两个元素后，它会变成 [1, 3, 2]。数组 [1, 2, 1, 3, 1, 2] 不是近乎唯一的，因为至少需要删除 3 个元素才能将其变成唯一数组。
因此，你的任务是将给定的唯一数组 s 拆分成两个近乎唯一的数组 a 和 b。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5）。
第二行包含 n 个互不相同的整数 s1、s2、...、sn（0 ≤ si ≤ 10^9）。

output.ai: 如果可以使 Alice 和 Bob 满意（即可以拆分给定的数组），请在第一行输出 "YES"（不含引号）。第二行输出数组 a，第三行输出数组 b。可能存在多个解，输出其中任意一个均可。
如果无法将 s 拆分为几乎唯一的数组 a 和 b，请在第一行输出 "NO"（不含引号）。

note.ai: 在样例中，我们可以从 a 中移除前两个元素，并从 b 中移除第二个元素，使它们都变得互不相同。
